oracle.invariant: The bridge passes the system's answer (allowed/denied, else unknown) and reads it again when a window gains focus, pushing only a change. denied: the amber card with Open System Settings; the sound picker and Send a test disabled with the reason, not hidden; the step not done. Back allowed after System Settings: the step turns Done; unknown: the on-card says the permission cannot be read.
oracle.productSourcesScope: file-level: the files the case imports, reads or runs (declaration line, or the first code line); the invariant is exercised through them, the executed assertion is the case command
